instruction_changes.deviation: A playable lab was delivered only after repeated subjective color tweaks. Existing difficult-choice and before-substantial-implementation wording failed to require it before the next small subjective iteration. Existing color guidance did not address foreground/background competition in the full composition.
instruction_changes.evidence: Direct user correction in frontend-design-lab: labs should be called earlier; a more saturated wallpaper draws attention from the object, and the design skill should attend to color theory.
instruction_changes.why_instruction: The loaded frontend entrypoint owns decision timing; its existing personal default and taste-selection reference own the playable comparison. Its existing color guidance owns composition-level hierarchy. This is a user-requested correction, not a model-specific capability claim.
instruction_changes.alternative: No change preserves the failed timing ambiguity. A lab implementation alone cannot carry the reusable trigger to later frontend work. A universal options gate would disrupt exact routine repairs; a new owner duplicates the existing skill.

decision_probes.case: The wallpaper still pulls attention from the object after several color revisions; make it a little less saturated.
decision_probes.expected: Make an in-context playable lab before another subjective tweak; numeric wording does not remove unresolved hierarchy.
decision_probes.assessment: Source decision-boundary review: explicit positive trigger.

decision_probes.case: Set the approved background to the supplied exact token; keep the accepted composition.
decision_probes.expected: Apply exact routine repair without a new options round; render and delivery checks still apply.
decision_probes.assessment: Source decision-boundary review: routine exception retained.

decision_probes.case: Choose the palette yourself; skip comparisons for this revision.
decision_probes.expected: Choose a provisional palette, judge hierarchy in context and preserve delivery checks.
decision_probes.assessment: Source decision-boundary review: explicit delegation/waiver retained.

checks.linked_references: Every relative link in changed Markdown resolves.
checks.ownership_purpose: Existing frontend ownership objective, added value and retirement test retained unchanged.

limits: Probes are source decision-boundary reviews, not fresh model inference, natural triggering or behavioral parity.
Color advice is a composition hypothesis to test in the render, not proof that muted backgrounds are universally superior.
